title: Taws brings AWS into your terminal — as a fast, keyboard-driven UI  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Managing AWS from the console is powerful, but it's also overwhelming. To brings AWS into your terminal, has a fast keyboard-driven UI. It lets you browse 94 AWS resource types across 60 services, switch profiles and regions instantly, and see changes in real time. Everything is Vim style. Navigate, filter, and inspect resources without touching a mouse. You can start, stop, or terminate EC2 instances directly from the UI.
